title: Python: Template string for SQL — safer than f-string
detail: string.Template used for SQL query — safer than f-strings. No attribute/method access allowed, only $var substitution. Still ensure input sanitization.
fix: ✅ Already using Template. Ensure $variables are sanitized via parameterized queries where possible.

title: Python: str.format() in SQL query — less safe than Template
detail: str.format() used in SQL query — allows attribute access like {0.__class__}. Prefer string.Template or parameterized queries.
fix: Replace with string.Template('SELECT * FROM t WHERE id=$id').substitute(id=val) or parameterized queries.

title: Python: raw string concatenation in SQL
detail: String concatenation with SQL — classic SQL injection vector. Use parameterized queries or Template.
fix: Use cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM t WHERE id=?', (user_id,)) or string.Template.
